gen-main-seed0.kernel_code:
import triton
import triton.language as tl
@triton.jit
def softmax_kernel(x_ptr, y_ptr, N, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
  pid = tl.program_id(0)
  offs = pid * N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
  m = tl.arange(0, BLOCK) < N
  x = tl.load(x_ptr + offs, mask=m, other=-float('inf'))
  x_max = tl.max(x, axis=0)
  num = tl.exp(x - x_max)
  den = tl.sum(num, axis=0)
  tl.store(y_ptr + offs, num / den, mask=m)
